Appearing on the Lex Fridman podcast sent revenue up 2.5x overall, with Photo AI up 3x — the $161K/mo day was that spike
Has shared revenue publicly on X for 10+ years; over 95% of his 70+ projects failed, worn as a badge of honor

description: Photo AI lets you train a personal AI model from your selfies and generate photorealistic photos and videos of yourself in any scenario — professional headshots, dating profile pics, lifestyle content and more. Built solo by indie hacker Pieter Levels, it uses DreamBooth fine-tuning on Flux-based models for consistent, lifelike results.

name: SiteGPT
tagline: Make AI your expert customer support agent

facts: Launched March 30, 2023 with a tweet — first customers within the hour, ~15K launch-day visitors
Show HN on April 2 hit the front page; Product Hunt on April 5 became #1 product of the day and #4 of the week
Crossed $10K MRR in under a month, then faced ~50% month-one churn; steadied around $15K MRR five months in, paid-only from day one
Previously built Feather, a Notion-based blogging platform, and exited it for $250K
In 2026: first $50K revenue month this year, and crossed $800K in total revenue — from a weekend side project

description: SiteGPT turns a website's content into a personalized AI customer-support chatbot — 'ChatGPT for your product' — that answers visitor questions 24/7. Train it by URL, sitemap, files, or integrations (Notion, Google Drive, GitHub), embed it anywhere, and escalate to humans when needed. Enterprise-grade security: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA assessed.

name: CodeGuide
tagline: Spec-driven Context For AI Coding

facts: Idea to $42K MRR in 90 days, with zero paid marketing — founder CJ Zafir tells the full story in his Starter Story video interview
Solves AI hallucination in coding: generates PRDs, tech specs, wireframes and 50-step implementation plans as spec-driven context
Ships 6 AI-optimized starter kits and boilerplates so developers don't burn tokens fixing setup errors
Trusted by 41,450+ developers; integrates Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Replit, Lovable and more

description: CodeGuide turns plain-English ideas into a complete project knowledge base — PRDs, tech specs, wireframes, and task lists — that AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code reference to write correct code. Its autonomous coding agent (Sv2) can analyze codebases and code for hours with 200+ models routed per task. Trusted by 41,450+ developers.

name: SocialCrawl
tagline: One scraper API for every social platform

facts: Built the first version in 2 weeks; first paying customer within 48 hours of launch — charged from day one
5th product after 4 failed AI consumer apps; founded Ridio in 2024, left academia summer 2025
Started her X account with 3 followers and posted every day; now 2,200+ followers — built in public so launch day arrived with a warm audience
Usage-based model, credits never expire: revenue accelerated when Growth customers upgraded to Pro; now onboarding enterprise clients

description: SocialCrawl is a unified social media scraping API covering 68 platforms with 651 endpoints under one auth token and one response schema. Built agent-ready with MCP support and SDKs in six languages, it powers brand monitoring, sentiment analysis, trend detection, and competitive intelligence. 100 free credits on signup; pay-as-you-go credit packs that never expire.

name: Yaak
tagline: The local-first API client

facts: Quit his job in 2024 to go full-time on Yaak; spent two years living off savings before the model worked
Novel monetization: MIT-licensed source free forever; charges only for commercial use of prebuilt binaries — 37 business + 421 individual subs
Businesses contribute $3,247 of ~$5K MRR despite being a small share of subscribers — the largest business account is ~80 seats
Previously built Insomnia, sold in 2019; Yaak is its spiritual successor — he chose local-first after cloud sync contributed to his burnout

description: Yaak is a local-first, open-source API client for REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, gRPC and SSE, built by the creator of Insomnia. Requests live on your machine and are versioned with Git, with no account or cloud sync required, and an agent-friendly CLI and MCP plugin let AI coding agents work in the same workspace.

name: Neural Frames
tagline: Audio-reactive AI music videos for musicians

facts: Started end of 2022 as an indie side project by physics PhD Nicolai Klemke
First traction came from the Stable Diffusion subreddit on Reddit; grew through a 30,000-word SEO guide on AI video generation
Hit $17k MRR by end of October 2023 (first-person founder Q&A)
Scaled to six-figure monthly revenue by Nov 2025; now a 12-person Berlin team — bootstrapped, profitable, ~6x year-over-year growth

description: Neural Frames is an AI music video platform built for musicians, turning songs into audio-reactive videos with visuals synced to rhythm, energy, and song structure. It offers three creation modes — Autopilot song-to-video, a frame-by-frame editor, and a text-to-video timeline editor powered by models like Kling, Seedance, and Runway — with 4K output, character consistency, and automatic lyric extraction. Trusted by 40,000+ artists, it includes AI upscaling on every export at no extra cost.

name: Zigpoll
tagline: Post-Purchase & On-Site Surveys for Shopify

facts: Solo founder arc: ~$10–15K MRR in 2022 → ~$1M ARR earlier this year → ~$142K MRR at interview; goal $2M ARR by year end
~90% of business flows through the Shopify App Store; reviews-first growth; ~100% year-over-year growth since 2022
Runs the whole company solo using AI coding agents across dev, design, marketing and support — while still personally answering support email

description: Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool built for eCommerce, especially Shopify stores, that triggers small interactive surveys at key moments like the post-purchase thank-you page. Responses are tied to real order data — revenue, AOV and repeat rate by channel — powering attribution surveys ("How did you hear about us?"), NPS and on-site polls.

name: WriteStack
tagline: Grow and Monetize Your Substack, Faster

facts: Crossed $11,000 MRR with 415 writers on the platform (founder's X post, Jul 21, 2026)
Platform has since grown to 4,130+ creators
Founder grew his own newsletter to 6,600+ subscribers using the same playbook

description: WriteStack is an all-in-one Substack growth platform for creators. It schedules Notes, shows exactly which Notes convert readers into subscribers, generates Notes in your own voice, filters notification noise into a 15-minute activity center, and includes an AI coach plus cross-posting to LinkedIn and X.

name: Launch Fast
tagline: The Amazon seller operating system for better product decisions

facts: Day 30 hit $10K MRR, Day 60 $17-18K, Day 90 $21.8K, now at $30K MRR
MVP built in 48 hours entirely in Cursor with zero audience; traded equity with the Legacy X coaching program for day-one distribution
Just shipped an MCP — "one of the first all-in-one agentic tools for Amazon sellers"; sellers research products, manage catalogs and optimize ads through AI without bouncing between five tools
330 active Chrome extension users at Day 90; subscription tiers $49/$89/$199 per month, all paying customers, no free tier

description: Launch Fast is an Amazon seller operating system for product research and launch decisions. It helps sellers find markets, validate products with historical trend data, analyze Amazon Ads performance, compare suppliers, and track rankings — all in one workflow instead of juggling tools like Jungle Scout and Helium 10. Plans include 3 free product research reports to start.

name: Visualizee.ai
tagline: Turn car photos into studio shots, furniture into product shots, 3D models into photoreal renders

facts: Product Hunt launch brought 200 signups in 4 days from 4,000 unique visitors, after 12 hours of active community engagement
Pre-launch: connected with ~400 people on LinkedIn for early visibility before shipping
Free tier plus paid renders from about $10 per render
Runs a portfolio model: the same revenue post shows he also operates viztunr.com and was launching morga.ai alongside

description: Visualizee.ai is a conversational AI rendering platform for architects and designers. Upload a SketchUp screenshot, sketch or photo, tell Vizzy what to change in plain words, and get a photoreal render that keeps your layout and camera — plus short AI-generated videos of your scenes.

name: CNVS
tagline: Canvas runs Claude, Cursor, and Codex in parallel on one canvas: you direct, they build, you ship.

facts: Lifetime licenses are '100x easier to sell than subscriptions' — the founder's own #1 lesson from the CNVS launch
Daily livestreaming 'forces you to actually show up' — the marketing engine is showing the work, every day
Built a 500+ member Discord community of vibecoders; their daily feedback 'made the app 1000x better'
Repeat playbook: his earlier iOS app Quickclaw went from $0 to $7,200 in seven days by listening to the market
Product edge: 100% voice-controlled, built in Swift, uses buyers' existing AI subscriptions with no API markup

description: CNVS is a native macOS app that runs Claude, Cursor, and Codex AI coding agents in parallel on one canvas, directed by voice. You orchestrate, the agents build, and you ship — from idea to first revenue without bottlenecks. It is sold as a one-time purchase with lifetime 1.x updates, no subscription.

name: Job Boardly
tagline: The all-in-one platform to build, launch, and monetize a professional job board on your own domain.

facts: Crossed $9k MRR 'one year on from the acquisition' — growing MRR every month 'up from sub $1k this time last year,' while steadily bringing down churn
July 2026 revenue was $9,193.10, down 9.63% on fewer annual signups, but MRR kept growing and churn kept falling
Launched a $30/mo monthly plan to make trying easier — 'actually… leading to more lifetime sales so far'
Site claims 1,000+ job boards built on the platform, rated 4.89/5 from 95 reviews

description: Job Boardly is all-in-one job board software to launch a professional job board on your own domain in about an hour. It backfills from 12M+ licensed live listings, monetizes via paywalls, employer subscriptions and featured listings through Stripe, and ships built-in SEO including Google Jobs schema.

name: Symmetry
tagline: Get an aesthetic physique by climbing ranks.

facts: Launched June 2025; the founders were fitness YouTubers in the Spanish-speaking market, and that existing audience gave the launch its initial spike
Roughly 3 million downloads across iOS and Android in about a year, with a dominant position in Spain and Mexico
UGC growth engine: nearly 80,000 videos posted in a year from 500+ creator accounts, close to a billion views — creators are paid nearly half the revenue they generate
Runs like a science lab: an internal 'EVELYN' experiment system documents every test, and nothing ships without an A/B test in PostHog — one onboarding commitment screen lifted retention 3.73%
Three-phase philosophy: build what founders want (terrible) → build what users request (mediocre) → only build what controlled experiments prove valuable

description: Symmetry is a fitness app for building an aesthetic physique: 100% personalized training plans generated in one click, tailored to your body and goals, backed by exercise science. Over 1 million users, with motivation mechanics built around climbing ranks.

name: Snag
tagline: Why pay for something when you can get it for free?

facts: Built 45+ apps in the past year; launched Snag with his 10x Studio team about four months before the interview (~May 2026)
Went from $0 to $30K MRR in under four months: 100,000+ authenticated users, 9,000 conversions, $80,000+ total proceeds, ~3,300 App Store ratings

Distribution engine: UGC creator campaigns at scale — interview and filter creators, keep the ~10% with virality, put winners on a monthly retainer plus CPM, then turn the best creatives into Meta ads
Economics per creative: one video hit 240,000 views; typically $1,000–$2,000 in subscription profit per 100,000 views
Build system: reverse-engineer the value proposition first, Figma-wireframe it, then AI-code the app (Cursor + Cloud Code) — a working app in about four to five hours

description: Snag helps you find and snag free items near you instead of paying for them — a local marketplace-style app for free stuff.

name: GainFrame
tagline: Progress photos that explain what changed.

facts: Free web tools bring ~46% of the site's search traffic: 9,923 of 21,645 Google clicks in the latest 28-day period (Aug 12–Sep 8, 2026)
App Store click events from tool pages grew 158% — from 100 to 258 across two consecutive 28-day periods
Sitewide Google clicks grew 7.5x across three 28-day periods (2,871 to 21,645); mid-September saw 1,477–1,598 clicks per day
Builds in public with monthly SEO/revenue updates; MRR was stalling around $2,000 five days before the Sep 15 post, then rose to $2,354.65

description: GainFrame is an iPhone app that turns gym selfies into physique intelligence: one photo produces estimated body fat, FFMI, lean mass and 12 muscle-group scores, aligned before/after comparisons, a Coach that explains what changed using your trend data, and honest projections of future you. Private by design — no account required.

name: Personal Best
tagline: The workout tracker for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

facts: Started May 2020 as a ~5-day hobby project during the COVID lockdowns — a quick v1.0 he kept improving because he enjoyed building it
Grew to 500,000+ downloads and ~50,000 monthly active users; featured on the App Store multiple times; made a cameo in the WWDC 2026 keynote
Almost no paid marketing — purely organic growth that picked up once Apple began featuring the app
No server-side component: the app runs entirely on the phone, so every subscription is almost 100% profit with virtually no marginal cost
Product-led growth via workout image-sharing — turn workouts into editorial-quality images to post on social

description: Personal Best is an indie workout tracker for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. It plans workouts, coaches you toward weekly goals, scrubs through workouts like video with animated route maps and pace charts, and turns workouts into shareable editorial-quality images — privacy-first with no ads.

name: Novastart
tagline: Apps and files on an infinite canvas where people and AI agents work together.
description: Novastart is an infinite canvas OS where apps, teammates and AI agents work together on one shared canvas. Founded by brothers Thomas and Nick Fraher in Los Angeles; they previously built and sold Aquavoss in 2025.

name: BridgeMind
tagline: The Agent Super App — a workspace for vibe coding

facts: $3,955 to $18,320 MRR in 90 days, posted on his own channel: 'boring, daily, relentless compounding' — he showed up and shipped on livestream every day for three months
$17,265.86 MRR, up 20.81% month over month — then 'surpassed $20,000 in MRR', with a stated goal of '$1M or bust'
Grew out of the founder's YouTube channel into a self-described 'agentic organization': ~74,000 YouTube subscribers, ~10,000 Discord members, ~31,000 X followers (May 2026)

description: BridgeMind is the Agent Super App: a native desktop workspace for vibe coding where AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more) work in real terminals, with multi-account switching, the fastest voice-to-prompt dictation, and coding threads you read instead of watch. You bring your own AI subscription or API key.

name: Instatus
tagline: Beautiful status pages & uptime monitoring
source_label: IdeaWave revenue tracker — founder-listed on ARRFounder, rechecked Oct 14, 2026

facts: Solo founder Ali Salah, a developer from Egypt, quit his job to build Instatus — a bootstrapped alternative to Atlassian Statuspage
Featured in Starter Story twice: the original interview on quitting his job to build it, and a five-year follow-up on running it solo
Founder-listed $50K MRR on ARRFounder, tracked daily by IdeaWave since Aug 1, 2026 — ranked #88 of 290 tracked startups

description: Instatus is a status page and uptime monitoring platform: monitor your services, fix incidents with your team from Slack or Teams, and publish beautiful public or private status pages in 30 seconds. Trusted by teams like Deno, Polymarket and Harvard.

name: Talanoa
tagline: Email that feels like chat
description: Talanoa turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox with private, on-device AI.

name: Navige
tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It routes suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results.

name: Superdraft
tagline: AI workspace for fully designed emails
description: Superdraft is an AI-powered workspace for creating fully designed emails. It brings campaign discovery, writing, design and editing together in one place.

name: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
tagline: Isolated cloud machines for your AI coding agents
description: Buddy Sandboxes give AI coding agents their own isolated Linux machines to build, run, test, and fix apps. Each sandbox has persistent disk, root access, Docker, SSH, and a public URL.

name: Basedash Connector gallery
tagline: See what you'll build before you connect a data source
description: The Basedash Connector gallery gives every data source its own home page with one-click connect, docs, sync controls, and live previews of dashboards and alerts.

name: Founders Today
tagline: Founder community & newsletter giving startups distribution — 854K+ product impressions delivered
description: Founders Today is Peter Oberlik's founder community and launch platform: 10,000+ founders, 854K+ product impressions delivered, and a publisher network that distributes launches to real audiences. Launching is free; paid BOOST distributes your product across tech publishers on an eCPM model.

name: Voicy
tagline: Write with your voice, everywhere — AI speech-to-text, 3x faster than typing
description: Voicy (usevoicy.com) is Kourosh Ghaffari's Whisper-powered AI speech-to-text app: dictation 3x faster than typing on every platform — Chrome, Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android. Built for seniors and accessibility users. (A different product from the Rotterdam sound-clip platform of the same name.)
source_label: Startup Finder profile (Oct 2026); founder's X bio self-reports ~$11K MRR

name: Palomino
tagline: Keep up with your agents
description: Palomino is a fast, GPU-rendered agent workspace that runs AI coding agents side by side with your terminals, editor, and browser in one window, natively on your Mac.

name: Taim
tagline: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI.
description: Taim is your thought-capture assistant. Speak your mind and it all falls into place: thoughts land in the right thread automatically, and to-dos become tasks, reminders, and calendar events. Connect via MCP, and every agent you use instantly has your context.
pricing: Free basic plan; Taim Pro $39.99/year (first year), then $90/year

name: DOYT
tagline: The Dynamic Island to-do app you don't have to open
description: DOYT pins your current task to the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, so you can see it, complete it, or move it to Later without opening the app.
pricing: Freemium — core free forever, Pro one-time purchase, 3-day trial

name: Tetriz Harness
tagline: Turn what your team learns into everyone's agent setup
description: Open-source tools for teams on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro. Harness Recommendations finds what's broken or risky in your agents' rules, skills, hooks, and permissions and proposes what's missing based on your team's sessions; the Harness Control Plane ships approved fixes team-wide.

name: Skisso
tagline: Point at your live UI, hand your AI agent the exact change
description: Skisso is a free Chrome extension for designers and developers who build with AI coding agents. Point at any element on your live product, edit it in your own design system, then hand your agent only the exact change — as a small diff or over MCP.

name: Calenteri
tagline: The GDPR-compliant alternative to Calendly
description: The GDPR-compliant alternative to Calendly. Share a booking link, let people pick a time. EU-hosted, zero third-party trackers, no cookie banners.
pricing: Freemium · Pro from €4/mo · Pro Forever €49 one-time

name: Draper
tagline: Validate, plan, and launch a business, one step at a time.
description: Draper is a start-a-business app. Test your idea, then build your brand, product and website and run your first ads, in order and all in one place.
founder: Benny Abbatangelo, Dexter Todd, Oliver Bagin
pricing: Freemium — first two workshops free, then $9/mo

name: Emochi
tagline: Voice journal to understand yourself through art and science
description: Emochi turns your voice notes into a living, generative character that reflects your emotional world — vent about your day, untangle a thought, or check in with yourself.
founder: Cynthia Lam, Mawuli Adjei, Vanessa Tam, James Hale

name: Caldera
tagline: Your Obsidian vault as a living profile and linked garden
description: Caldera turns your Obsidian vault into a living profile and a digital garden you grow in public, and your GitHub repos into a living 3D city. Sign up with GitHub or install the Obsidian plugin, and your page updates itself.
pricing: Free — open source, no paid tier listed on the site

name: Spiralens
tagline: Golden ratio camera that tells you where to move your phone
description: Spiralens is an Android camera for people who never learned composition — tap your subject, follow the arrow, and shoot when the ring turns green.

name: LooGo
tagline: Find public restrooms fast
description: LooGo finds public restrooms near you in seconds — door codes, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility details, with a Wear OS companion app. No ads, no tracking.
pricing: Free — no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases

name: MAVI
tagline: AI-driven finance staffing platform connecting U.S. finance teams with vetted global finance professionals.
description: MAVI is an AI-driven finance talent engine that places pre-vetted global finance and accounting talent — every candidate clears a 5-stage vetting process, with only the top 2% making it through. Its matching engine, trained on hundreds of thousands of applicants and validated by human experts, delivers US-caliber (often ex-Big 4) talent at 50%+ lower cost, onboarded in as fast as 5 days. MAVI stays on as a continuous partner handling contracts, payments, and compliance, with contractors working in a secure SOC 2-compliant virtual environment.

name: Lantern AI
tagline: People infrastructure for AI agents: 70+ recruiting and people-data tools behind one connection.
description: Lantern is an AI recruiting platform for connected hiring, built on two models: a World People Model that knows the talent market (career paths, what people built, title calibration) and a Company Hiring Model that learns each team's taste from debriefs, scorecards, and past decisions. Sourcing, application review, AI interviews, meeting intelligence, and analytics all share one hiring context, so what one interview teaches improves the next search — while the hiring team keeps final decision control. It is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified with GDPR compliance.

name: Workflows
tagline: Go-to-market systems for revenue growth
pricing: Custom — subscription or sprint engagements; free playbooks, paid Academy
description: Workflows is a go-to-market systems agency for B2B tech companies. Instead of selling software, they embed as a strategic GTM partner — delivering LinkedIn content engines, automated outbound sequences, RevOps infrastructure, and ABM programs, all built on an AI-first tech stack. Client results include Freckle (42% month-over-month growth over 6 months, 640+ Tier-1 signups from outbound).

name: Timeliner
tagline: Operating system for video agencies, with AI-powered QC for video production.
description: Timeliner is the operating system for video agencies. One platform for the entire video workflow: assign editors, review footage with timecoded comments, get client approvals in branded portals, schedule posts across social channels, and track payments. Replaces seven tools (ClickUp, Frame.io, Google Drive, Slack, etc.) with one $89/mo platform. Trusted by video teams in 15+ countries, 4.8/5 on G2.

name: EstiMate
tagline: EstiMate AI helps construction teams generate accurate estimates from project documentation.
description: EstiMate is AI construction estimating software for Australian builders: upload your plan PDFs and it reads them, measures the job by trade with quantities traced back to the drawings, then you price it on your rates and export a quote-ready PDF. $200M+ of projects quoted.

name: Clinware
tagline: AI software for optimizing post-acute and skilled nursing care operations.
description: Clinware is AI software for skilled nursing and assisted living: a post-acute platform spanning admissions (referral packet review, insurance verification, EHR pre-fill), clinical insights and quality measure tracking, and workforce scheduling tied to resident acuity. HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 certified, built by clinicians.

name: Inbox Zero
tagline: Clean up your inbox in minutes. Open source.
description: Inbox Zero is an open-source AI email assistant and email client: auto-labels email, drafts replies in your voice, blocks cold email, bulk unsubscribes. Free app; AI plans from $18/mo.
pricing: Freemium — free email app; AI plans from $18/user/mo, 7-day free trial

name: Krea 3
tagline: The world's fastest frontier image model.
description: Krea 3 is Krea's new in-house image editing model: production-grade edits in under 8 seconds at ~$0.06 per 2K image — 4× faster than Nano Banana Pro. Freemium, from $5/mo.
pricing: Freemium — free plan; paid plans from $5/mo (Basic: 5,000 compute units/mo); Krea 3 edits ~$0.06 each at 2K

name: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse
tagline: Amazon's personal AI memory, now on your wrist or phone
description: Bee Frontier ($74.99) is Amazon's wrist-worn personal AI wearable; Bee Eclipse (from $99.99, coming soon) is a credit-card-sized magnetic phone attachment. Both turn conversations into summaries, reminders and to-dos.
pricing: Frontier $74.99 (available now); Eclipse from $99.99 (coming soon); Bee Pro $11.99/mo

name: Tomo for ChatGPT
tagline: Feed your curiosity. Any topic, played like Duolingo.
description: Tomo for ChatGPT is Mohannad Ali's learning app inside ChatGPT: add the Tomo plugin, ask for a course on anything, and play it Duolingo-style right in the chat. Free to start.
pricing: Free — free plan forever, no credit card; paid plan available

name: Openbroca
tagline: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
description: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac (a 6.5 MB download). Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you type — free up to 3,000 text units a week.
pricing: Freemium — free up to 3,000 text units/week, Unlimited $6.99/mo or $59.99/yr

name: Real Work From Anywhere
tagline: Work From Anywhere Jobs - Fully Remote Worldwide
description: Real Work From Anywhere is the #1 job board for work from anywhere jobs, carefully curated from 100% worldwide remote companies. Unlike generic remote job boards, it only lists jobs that let you work from anywhere in the world — complete geographical freedom with just an internet connection. The team verifies that each company hires worldwide before listing, and keeps checking for location restrictions. Free for job seekers, no account needed.

name: Glasa
tagline: B2B Lead Generation & Sales Intelligence Platform
description: Glasa is an AI-powered B2B lead generation platform with 800M+ verified contacts. Its AI agents find, qualify, and book dream clients — scanning 35+ live data sources, triple-verifying every email (99.2% deliverability), and enriching profiles automatically. All-in-one GTM platform: prospect search, inbox warmup, email sequences, and unified inbox on a single credit balance. 7-day free trial with 500 credits.

name: Ritmo
tagline: Dating app for active singles who love sport and fitness
description: Ritmo is a dating app for people who love sport, fitness and staying active. Build a profile around your favourite sports, training habits and personal bests, discover sporty singles nearby, match, chat and meet in real life. Built solo by Adel in 6 weeks — $0 to $4k MRR, 7,000 users, 400,000+ swipes, 4.5 stars on the App Store.

name: Lookout (for Slack)
tagline: Urgent Slack messages, handled instantly. Powered by Jev.
description: Lookout watches your Slack channels for time-sensitive messages and takes the action you choose the moment one lands — an emoji reaction, a DM, a Linear issue, a Notion page, or a webhook.
pricing: Free during beta — paid plans coming soon

name: DoOne
tagline: Focus timer with integrations with GitHub, Gitlab & More
description: DoOne is a task list with a built-in focus timer for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Plan the day in three lists, pick one task, and the timer runs for that task until you finish it or take a break.
pricing: Freemium — free app; DoOne Pro $4.99 one-time purchase (no subscription)

name: Triwarden
tagline: Native Mac password manager for Vaultwarden & Bitwarden
description: A native Mac password manager for Vaultwarden and Bitwarden, with Touch ID unlock, Auto-Type, an SSH agent, and a command palette. Free for personal use.
pricing: Freemium — free for personal use, one-time license US$19.99 (required for work use)

name: AutoChart.eu
tagline: Turn any song into a full-band chart for YARG and Clone Hero
description: Upload an MP3 or FLAC and AutoChart.eu turns it into a complete, ready-to-play song folder for YARG or Clone Hero — drums, guitar, bass, vocals and synced lyrics, charted automatically by AI. Your first song is free.
pricing: Freemium — 1st song free, then credit packs: €3.00 for 1 song, €20.00 for 10, €40.00 for 40 (€1.00/song); no subscription, credits never expire

name: Lancetta
tagline: Know when to push your coding agents, and when to ease off
description: Lancetta is a free native macOS menu-bar app that reads Codex and Claude Code quota and tells you when to push on, slow down, switch agents, or trim what your agents load at every start.

name: Reloop
tagline: Open-source email API & infrastructure for developers
description: Reloop is an open-source email API and infrastructure platform built for developers — an alternative to AWS SES. It offers transactional and marketing email delivery, SMTP relay, incoming email webhooks, AI agent inboxes, and deliverability tooling (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP warmup, blocklist tracking), available as a hosted cloud service or fully self-hosted under Apache 2.0. Trusted by 250+ developers, with first-party SDKs for Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, PHP and Ruby.
